reference_observations.description: Revisit in 1858 with actual Darwin question/witness sources. Decimal quantities and radical/division structure are not safely represented by flattened integer-like text.
Fox sampling claims, keeper/breeder reports and challenges to common descent remain attributed; absence of observed unpaired birds is not a census proving their absence.

corrections.description: First pass reads flattened123pages as123pages. The accepted raw source reading establishes 1⅔ severely damaged pages, with missing pages separately described. Brushfield body spelling also differs from the editorial summary Birchfield.
Retain all three actual diagrams, full enclosure and mathematical operators; a generic reference to one diagram is not complete visual coverage.
Before February20,1866 is conjectural. Preserve the historical family-context reasoning and unresolved exact date rather than treating the upper bound as proof of a unique composition day.
Personal or family subject does not itself rule out a conversation pair. Missing counterpart, temporal scope and surviving extent supply the actual exclusions.

summary: Eleven targets and eight older contexts reuse matched primary readings. Erasmus 2278 is a 1858 bee-cell geometry lead with three actual images and a full enclosure. Other targets have later contexts or conjectural later-date holds. No new current-period edges. Older purchases, forwarded instructions, family news and Fox exchanges do not become prompts for later public letters.
